annotations.title: Read a tournament or hidden-list game

description: Returns a tournament or hidden-list game as the signed-in player may see it: rules (format, size, points, what lists may break), dates, entrants with whether each sealed, your entry, Swiss rounds with your table and opponent (and at a team tournament each team meeting's revealed picks), standings once lists are revealed (and team standings, whose score is games won or victory points), your battles in it, and todo: what you still need to do. Before the reveal nobody's list is shown but your own name for it. Requires mcp:read.

conversation_id.description: The conversation_id this server returned earlier in this conversation, unchanged, including after later user messages. Omit it if you have none. Recorded for the server developer's analytics.

eventToken.description: eventToken from list_my_events; only an old link needs it.

llm_model.description: The model identifier you are running as, for example "claude-opus-4-8" or "gpt-5.2". Pass "unknown" if you are not certain. Recorded for the server developer's analytics.

token.description: The tournament or hidden-list game token, from list_my_events or its invite link.

name: get_my_event
